item.description:

item.title: Civilian plane crash in New Mexico tied to military GPS blocking
item.description:
📝 (It turned out that US Customs and Border Patrol were using anti-drone lasers in that area. They have to practice until they become so efficient that they can stay calm under pressure, lest they panic, lose their situational awareness, and spiral out of control. Under normal circumstances, the flight that followed would have been uneventful.
